EC1: Tuberculosis resistant to [AND] any of the study drugs (isoniazid [OR], rifampin [OR], EMB [OR], PZA [OR], CFZ [OR], Pto)
EC3: History of allergy [OR] or intolerance [AND] to any of the study drugs
EC4: Serum aminotransferase (AST [OR] or ALT) 3x upper limit of normal or higher
EC5: Pregnant [OR] or nursing females, [OR] or plan to become pregnant [OR] or nurse during the study period
EC6: Males planning to conceive a child during the study [OR] or within 6 months of cessation of treatment.
EC7: Any treatment [AND] directed against active tuberculosis within 6 months preceding initiation of study drugs.
EC8: Suspected [OR] or documented tuberculosis involving the central nervous system [OR] and/or bones [OR] and/or joints [OR], and/or miliary tuberculosis [OR] and/or pericardial tuberculosis.
EC10: HBV infected [OR] or HCV infected (these increase the risk of TB-drug induced hepatotoxicity)
EC12: Known allergy [OR] or intolerance [AND] to any of the study medications.
EC13: Individuals will be excluded from enrollment if, at the time of enrollment, their M. tuberculosis isolate is already known to be resistant to any of the study drugs.
EC15: Other medical conditions, that, in the investigator's judgment, make study participation not in the individual's best interest.
EC16: Current [OR] or planned incarceration [OR] or other involuntary detention
EC17: Having participated in other clinical studies [AND] with dosing of investigational agents within 8 weeks prior to trial start or currently enrolled in an investigational study [AND] that includes treatment with medicinal agents. Subjects who are participating in observational studies or who are in a follow up period of a trial that included drug therapy may be considered for inclusion.
